title: From / Reply-To Domain Discrepancy
description: Reply-To address points to a different domain than sender, a hallmark of BEC and email spoofing.

title: Executive / Wire Transfer Language
description: Email contains requests for direct wire transfer, gift cards, or confidential employee action.
pattern: (?i)(wire transfer|gift card|payroll update|direct deposit|confidential task|are you at your desk)

title: Failed SPF / DKIM Authentication
description: Email headers indicate sender failed cryptographic domain authentication checks.
